title: TOPA — ADVERSARIAL FALSIFICATION / SURVIVOR PASS
motto: NOTHING SUPERNATURAL — ONLY NATURE NOT YET UNDERSTOOD.
mission: Attempt to destroy every explanatory claim, mundane or extraordinary. Preserve for escalation only claims that remain testable and survive multiple independent attacks with adequate data.

classification.REFUTED: The frozen claim fails a decisive contradiction, failed prediction, provenance collapse, or better demonstrated explanation.
classification.PROBABLE_CONVENTIONAL: A conventional model explains most or all observations with fewer unsupported assumptions; residuals are not independently strong enough to preserve an extraordinary interpretation.
classification.UNRESOLVED_NONEXOTIC: The event/cause remains unresolved, but no surviving evidence specifically supports an extraordinary interpretation.
classification.DATA_POOR_SURVIVOR: The claim cannot currently be killed because the necessary data are absent, not because it survived a strong test. No promotion allowed.
classification.HARD_SURVIVOR: Adequate evidence exists and the case survives multiple independent, relevant falsification attacks. This means high-value unresolved, not paranormal confirmation.

current_sweep.case: Piri Reis ancient Antarctica / ancient aerial survey / visitor interpretation
current_sweep.killed_claim: The 1513 map requires ancient advanced aerial surveying or extraterrestrial knowledge.
current_sweep.reason: Historical cartographic reconstruction provides coherent early-modern source genealogy; extraordinary Antarctica/ancient-survey readings are not required and are rejected by specialist scholarship.
current_sweep.survives: The map is historically remarkable; the extraordinary interpretation does not.

current_sweep.killed_claim: The film itself demonstrates extraordinary structured craft.
current_sweep.reason: Condon-era photogrammetric analysis found the film compatible with white birds/gulls at plausible distance and speed; absent range makes exotic speed/size estimates underdetermined.
current_sweep.survives: Witness testimony about a closer disc-like impression remains testimony-only and is DATA_POOR, not a hard survivor.

current_sweep.killed_claim: A verified extraordinary craft engaged in a dogfight with Gorman.
current_sweep.reason: A lighted weather balloon was released in the relevant area/time; relative-motion pursuit plus later celestial confusion provides a coherent composite explanation.
current_sweep.survives: Historical perception/pursuit case, not extraordinary evidence.

current_sweep.killed_claim: All Lubbock reports represent one extraordinary craft phenomenon.
current_sweep.reason: Main moving formations have strong bird/plover explanations; separately sourced photographs and other reports must not be merged into one object.
current_sweep.survives: Some subreports remain individually data-poor after cluster disaggregation.

current_sweep.killed_claim: The reports establish a structured extraordinary vehicle.
current_sweep.reason: Bolide/fireball behavior fits luminosity and rapid passage; apparent windows/structure lack instrument or physical confirmation.
current_sweep.survives: Structural detail as testimony-only residual, DATA_POOR.

current_sweep.killed_claim: An extraordinary object caused Mantell's death.
current_sweep.reason: Hypoxia/anoxia during high-altitude pursuit is the strong aviation mechanism; a high-altitude Skyhook-type balloon remains the strongest object candidate, though a specific launch identity is reconstructed rather than perfectly documented.
current_sweep.survives: Exact object identity is not perfectly closed; extraordinary causation is not supported.

current_sweep.killed_claim: The radar wave as a whole demonstrates extraordinary craft over Washington.
current_sweep.reason: Condon radar analysis found atmospheric conditions conducive to anomalous propagation and judged most unidentified radar returns most likely AP; most visual objects were compatible with meteors or scintillating stars.
current_sweep.survives: Any residual visual report must be treated separately and cannot inherit radar evidentiary weight.

current_sweep.killed_claim: Vehicle stalls and lights jointly require one extraordinary craft.
current_sweep.reason: Storm/electrical conditions, ball-lightning/St. Elmo-type candidates and ordinary vehicle ignition vulnerabilities provide plausible mechanisms for much of the cluster; anecdotes are insufficient to establish a single causal object.
current_sweep.survives: Residual witness details are DATA_POOR unless independent vehicle/electrical records are recovered.

current_sweep.killed_claim: Radar-return merge proves collision, absorption or abduction by an extraordinary craft.
current_sweep.reason: Finite radar resolution can merge two close returns without physical contact; a relevant Canadian C-47 flight and training-intercept context exist; route disagreement becomes a trajectory problem. Mechanical/weather/icing/loss-of-control explanations retain meaningful priors.
current_sweep.survives: The fatal disappearance itself remains unresolved because the wreckage/cause is not established. Extraordinary interaction does not survive as an evidential conclusion.

current_sweep.killed_claim: Reported apparent speed/shape alone proves extraordinary technology.
current_sweep.reason: No independent instrument fixed range, size or speed; mirage/cloud/aircraft/perceptual models cannot be decisively selected or rejected from the surviving data.
current_sweep.survives: A historically credible unresolved visual report, quarantined below hard-survivor level.

current_sweep.killed_claim: Experienced-pilot status alone fixes extraordinary speed/size/origin.
current_sweep.reason: Two pilots provide a notable report but no independent instrument fixes the objects' range, size or velocity; geometry cannot be reconstructed tightly enough for a hard survivor.

current_sweep.killed_claim: The sighting is already resolved as the Sputnik-1 R-7 core-stage reentry.
current_sweep.reason: The current source chain gives 01:30 CET on December 1, but multiple space-history sources place the R-7 core-stage reentry on December 2; an estimated deorbit epoch reported in secondary orbital discussion is about 08:46 UTC December 2. Other catalogs summarize the decay as December 1, creating a material date-system conflict. Until the original 1957 sighting source, Swissair log and authoritative terminal orbit/decay record are recovered, the reentry identification does not close.
current_sweep.survives: A reported luminous descending cylinder whose exact time, wording, geometry and source genealogy remain incomplete. It is not a HARD_SURVIVOR yet.
current_sweep.lesson: A mundane explanation is not protected merely because it is mundane.

killed_claims: three channels automatically mean three independent causes
the ELINT return by itself proves an airborne emitter
instantaneous extraordinary acceleration was directly instrument-measured
current_sweep.reason_survives: The report has multiple crew members, contemporary military-document lineage recovered by later researchers, visual observations, passive ELINT reports and reported ground-radar correlation. Conventional components such as ground radar, meteors and ordinary aircraft plausibly explain portions, but no demonstrated conventional reconstruction currently reproduces the entire reported correlated sequence. Condon left the event unidentified while stressing the missing records and decade-delayed recollections.
weaknesses: No surviving public raw ELINT recording or radar film establishes the source.
Crew memory conflicts over whether recording media existed.
Some ELINT episodes may be causally dependent on ordinary ground radars.
Later reconstruction is stronger than Condon's initial file but still not equivalent to raw sensor data.
current_sweep.meaning: Current strongest TOPA survivor in this sweep means high-value unresolved correlated event, not paranormal or extraterrestrial confirmation.

current_sweep.killed_claim: The verified cutoff itself proves a direct government order or knowledge of extraterrestrial craft.
current_sweep.reason: The cutoff is a real broadcast event; causal attribution to a direct government command is not established by the public evidence.

current_sweep.killed_claim: Documented secrecy automatically implies secret government knowledge of extraterrestrial origin.
current_sweep.reason: Cold War military secrecy, classification and inconsistent public-information policy are independently expected. They establish secrecy in some contexts, not the hidden object's identity.
current_sweep.survives: Specific document-withholding questions only; ET-knowledge inference does not.

art_bell_corpus_first_sweep.rule: The existence of a preserved call proves that the report was made, not that its extraordinary interpretation is true.
refuted_examples: 1998 Jameson: Clinton would be the last elected U.S. president — FAILED_PREDICTION
1998 Night Cloud: Pacific Northwest tsunami by end of August 1998 — FAILED_PREDICTION
2001 self-described future caller: George H. W. Bush re-election / mad-cow devastation — FAILED_PREDICTIONS
1997 frantic Area 51 caller: later hoax-character claim makes the extraordinary identity claim at least strongly contaminated; satellite outage causation remains unestablished
art_bell_corpus_first_sweep.quarantine: Self-described time travelers, aliens, MIB, secret employees, apparitions, entities and similar claims without external testable records are DATA_POOR or CLAIM_ONLY, not survivors.
art_bell_corpus_first_sweep.candidate_for_deeper_test: The 2001 Vietnam-veteran/twin story is preserved as DOC_TESTABLE_UNRESOLVED because it alleges an externally checkable hospitalization outcome; even if the outcome is verified, after-death causation would still require timing and information-leakage tests.
art_bell_corpus_first_sweep.effect: The 136-record corpus collapses from 136 anomaly candidates to a much smaller set of cases with independent falsifiable hooks.

survivor_queue.killer_test: Build a timestamped causal graph from the 745th ACWRON TWX, 55th Wing intelligence summary, Airborne Observer Data Sheet and any Duncanville/Keesler radar operation records. Test whether ordinary ground-radar lobes + ordinary visual targets can reproduce every claimed correlation without post-hoc stitching.

Recover the 1957 Tribune de Geneve/Tiroler Tageszeitung source and Swissair Athens-Cairo flight/crew log; recover an authoritative 1957-001A terminal state/decay epoch. If the stage was still in orbit ~32 hours after the claimed observation, kill the Sputnik-reentry explanation and test bolide, aircraft, military and other reentry candidates.

Reconcile the F-89 and VC-912 trajectories with uncertainty envelopes, radar resolution, weather and fuel state. If ordinary-aircraft intercept plus accident chain fits, close the anomaly lane while preserving the aviation-loss uncertainty.

Ignore Art Bell relays as primary evidence; reconstruct independent witnesses, exact times/azimuths/elevations, military flare/aircraft activity and astronomy. Split early formation from later stationary lights before scoring.

Recover caller identity/date/location if lawfully sourceable, independently verify hospitalization timing, freeze what information the caller could have known beforehand, and test coincidence/leakage/post-hoc reconstruction before any extraordinary interpretation.

spiral_policy.turn_1: Attack the strongest conventional explanation with equal force.
spiral_policy.turn_2: Attack the surviving evidence itself: source, clock, sensor, geometry, independence.
spiral_policy.turn_3: Attempt predictive or archival killer test.
spiral_policy.ascend: Promote only if the case remains testable and survives; otherwise refute, resolve, or quarantine.
spiral_policy.repeat: A HARD_SURVIVOR is never final; it becomes the first target of the next spiral.

current_result.most_important_mundane_model_failure: Ras el-Kanayis = Sputnik-1 core-stage reentry is no longer an acceptable resolved label because of a serious decay-date/epoch conflict.
current_result.largest_archive_collapse: Art Bell caller corpus: most extraordinary identities are claim-only/data-poor; failed frozen predictions are directly refuted.
